items.question: Which seats are prescribed for brahmin and kshatriya practitioners?
premises: Lion and serpent-thigh seats are named.
Brahmin and kshatriya are the recipients.
items.inference: The verse assigns lion and serpent-thigh seats to brahmin and kshatriya practitioners.

items.plain_english: The lion seat and serpent-thigh seat are prescribed for brahmins and kshatriyas.
